title: Reproducibility release for "Validation hierarchy and directed transfer reveal limited gut microbiome signature transportability across melanoma immunotherapy cohorts"
description: Version-locked reproducibility companion for the associated melanoma immunotherapy gut-microbiome transportability study. The archive contains privacy-safe derived inputs, frozen results, reproducibility code, environment specifications, and figure-source materials. Analysis code is licensed under MIT. Project-created derived tables, figures, and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Raw public sequencing data are not redistributed or relicensed and remain subject to the original provider terms.
